# What do I owe HMRC on 31 January and 31 July?

> Free UK payments on account calculator: enter your Self Assessment bill to see the balancing payment, the two advance instalments, why your first January bill is about 150%, and what a reduction claim would defer. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
